column1: # Table S3: Wild-type versus modification-deficient calls on the shared testable universe.

# note: The shared testable universe of a pair is the set of exonic positions with coverage >= 10 and a modification-compatible reference base in both samples; the ratio is the deficient-condition count over the wild-type count there (Fig. 2A). Deficient samples are fip37 KD (Arabidopsis), Mettl3 KO (mouse) and the unmodified HeLa IVT library; KO/KD are partial negatives, so the ratio is an enrichment change, not a specificity measure. The coverage-matched ratio column recomputes the counts inside matched coverage strata (10/20/30/50/100/200/400 reads); mouse has one pair per study and no interval.
